properties.name: file_format
properties.description: The primary file format in which the track is encoded.

properties.name: bed_core_columns
properties.description: For BED-family formats, the number of standard (core) BED columns present — the N in "BEDN". Only relevant when file_format is a BED-family format.

properties.name: bed_extra_columns
properties.description: For BED-family formats, the number of extra/custom columns appended after the core columns — the M in "BEDN+M". Only relevant when file_format is a BED-family format.
